missing.why: Stretching Strikes (Q) flings two enemies toward each other: moves an enemy toward a point, which fits the pull term, but Zac has no pull label. Fix: data (label).
The most-typed pull champion, but his base range is 450 (ranged), so correctly excluded. Expect many wrong guesses; not a data fix.
R drags the target, but base range 350 makes him ranged; players think of him as a melee-ish bruiser. Correctly excluded by the Rule; players will dispute.

disputable.why: Impale pulls via a suppression-drag; most count it, a few see it as a 'carry' not a pull.
Apotheosis (R) pulls at the end; few players remember it as a pull.
Fate Sealed pulls enemies toward the end point; some see it as a knock-up only.

wording.why: Many players don't know Thresh/Urgot count as ranged; 'melee' is defined by base range, not playstyle.
wording.suggestion: Keep; a reveal note naming Thresh as ranged would cut confusion.

fun.why: Blitzcrank, Nautilus, Darius are easy; Diana, Kled, Yone, K'Sante reward depth. The Thresh trap adds tension.

champion:Blitzcrank.why: Rocket Grab is the definitive hook.

champion:Darius.why: Apprehend is iconic for top laners.

champion:Aatrox.why: Infernal Chains pull is known to top players.

champion:Kled.why: Beartrap on a Rope is a real pull few remember.

champion:Yone.why: R pull overlooked in favour of knock-up.

champion:Zaahen.why: Newest champion; few know his W.

Beartrap on a Rope literally drags enemies; satisfying reveal.
